luiskr.com V3 — website

The public-facing site — the portfolio a visitor actually sees. website/ contains every routed view (<view-home>, <view-project>, <view-legal>, <view-not-found>) and every presentational component they mount: the nav, the dialogs, the carousels, the mosaic, the media pipeline, the footer — plus the visual-effects modules that give the site its character (VHS glitch portrait, paper-burn titles, WebGL skeletons and widgets).

Everything here builds on core/ primitives and renders through shared/src (the app shell) — website owns no boot code, only views and components.

How a page is made

  1. The router (in core/) resolves the URL — locale prefix + localized slug → route.
  2. shared/src/app/view.ts lazy-imports the view's chunk and mounts its element into #view-outlet.
  3. The view's custom element (e.g. <view-home>) fetches its translation/content nodes via the SWR data layer — bundled snapshot instantly, Firebase revalidate.
  4. It renders JSX into a shadow root, mounts its children, keeps JSON-LD in sync, and pushes loaded data down into section components.

Home.tsx<view-home> — hero carousel, about section, mosaic grid, contact footer, awards strip. Three SWR sources fetched in parallel; JSON-LD kept in sync.
children.tsPushes loaded translations/items into section children.
data.tsData loading — pages/home, components/projects, pages/about + profile picture.
render.tsxJSX template — the hero mosaic, about, contact footer, awards.
scroll.tsPost-navigation scroll — same-view #about/#contact re-scrolls after the route fade.
types.tsShapes — portfolio list item, pages/home node, pages/about node.

Project.tsx<view-project> — hero cover, case-study sections (media + copy), awards, related carousel. Owns the expand modal and the project JSON-LD graph.

Root files

FileWhat it does
index.tsBarrel — importing it self-registers every <view-*> element transitively.
dev.tsStandalone dev entry — boots the real app shell through the module vite config.
vite.config.jsLibrary build — emits website/dist/website.js.

Commands

yarn dev      # boots the real app shell (shared/src) through this module's vite config
yarn test     # jest suite for website
yarn build    # emits website/dist/website.js

Submodule of luiskr.com-V3. Install deps from the superproject (yarn install at the root), then run yarn dev / yarn test / yarn build in this folder — see package.json scripts.
